Gated and merged. Candidate 9e20611f, merged tree cd1d893b, GATE_EXIT=0, 17 suite totals, 1295 tests, 0 errors, 0 failures. All three phantom types are now final classes.

Process note against myself: the FIRST run of this gate looked green -- 17 totals, zero errors, trailing [success] -- and I could not certify it, because I had not captured an exit status. A trailing [success] belongs to whichever sbt command emitted it, not to the chain, so it cannot distinguish a completed run from one killed after the last suite. I re-ran it in the same export with the status captured rather than reasoning from the shape of the log. Rule 4 exists for exactly this and I nearly skipped it on my own work.
